Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IISER Pune Research Associate Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the IISER Pune Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The post name for the IISER Pune Recruitment 2026 is Research Associate. This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Research Associate post at IISER Pune.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Associate position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. in Experimental Condensed Matter Physics with a specialization in optics of layered semiconductors.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Research Associate post is 35 years. Age relaxation may be considered.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 47,000/- per month plus 24% House Rent Allowance.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is a Walk-in Interview. No online application is required.

faq.question: Q7. When is the Walk-in Interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview is scheduled for 12 August 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST categories for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the location of IISER Pune?
faq.answer: IISER Pune is located in Pune, Maharashtra, with the pincode 411008.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificate (if applicable).
